subject: [PATCH 2/4] mm/huge_memory: skip zone device folios in madvise_free_huge_pmd()

2026-07-28.patch_summary: This patch modifies the madvise_free_huge_pmd() function to skip zone device memory when resolving folios for lazyfree marking. The existing checks in the surrounding guards do not cover all cases, particularly for present zone device PMDs. By adding a check for zone device folios and bailing out if one is found, this patch ensures that such memory is not mistakenly marked as lazyfree.
